Ukufundwa kwenzwa yehadiwe bukhoma kusuka ku-PC yakho exhunyiwe.
Yethula izinhlelo zakho ze-PC ozithandayo ngokuqondile esikrinini sakho sasekhaya.
Xhuma ku-PC yakho nge-Wi-Fi ukuze usebenzise lesi sici.

I-RemEx ikuvumela ukuthi usebenzise i-PC yakho kusuka kufoni yakho. Yilawule, vula izinhlelo zokusebenza, hlola ukuthi isebenza kanjani, futhi ubone nesikrini sayo. Masikuxhume ngezinyathelo ezimbalwa ezisheshayo.

Ngaphambi kokuxhuma, ikhompyutha yakho idinga ukuba nohlelo lokusebenza lwe-RemEx olusebenzayo. Kukhona uhlelo lokusebenza olulodwa nje okufanele ulufake — luqala ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ungena kukhompyutha yakho futhi lulinda ifoni yakho ukuthi ixhumeke. Thola inguqulo yakamuva ku-GitHub bese uyisebenzisa ngaphambi kokubhangqa.

Indlela elula yokuxhuma iwukuvumela i-RemEx ithole i-PC yakho. 1. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-RemEx lusebenza ku-PC yakho 2. Qinisekisa ukuthi ifoni yakho ne-PC kuse-Wi-Fi network efanayo 3. Esikrinini sokuxhuma, thepha \'Engeza i-PC\', bese \'Thola ngokuzenzakalelayo\' I-RemEx ifuna i-PC yakho kunethiwekhi yasekhaya futhi ikugcwalisele ikheli layo.

Uma i-RemEx ingakwazi ukuthola i-PC yakho ngokwayo, ungaxhuma mathupha. Okokuqala, thola ikheli le-IP lendawo le-PC yakho: Windows: Vula i-Command Prompt → thayipha i-ipconfig Bheka i-‘IPv4 Address’ (isib. 192.168.1.42) Linux: Vula i-terminal bese usebenzisa i-ip addr Ungaphinde ubone ikheli le-IP efasiteleni le-RemEx ku-PC yakho.

Uma usunalo ikheli lakho le-IP: 1. Iya esikrinini sokuxhuma (Okuningi → Ukuxhuma) 2. Thepha okuthi ‘Engeza i-PC’, bese uthepha okuthi ‘Engeza mathupha’, bese ufaka ikheli le-IP le-PC yakho 3. Faka iphothali (okuzenzakalelayo ngu-5005) 4. Thepha okuthi ‘Londoloza futhi uxhume’ 5. Uma ucelwa, faka i-PIN enamadijithi angu-6 eboniswe ku-PC yakho ukuze uqedele ukubhangqa okuphephile Imininingwane yakho yokuxhuma ilondolozwa ukuze uyisebenzise ngokuzayo.

Usukulungele ukuthatha izintambo. Vula %1$s ukuze ubuke ukufundwa bukhoma kwe-PC yakho. Amanye amathebhu akuvumela ukuthi uthumele imiyalo, uqale izinhlelo zokusebenza, ubone okusebenzayo, uphequlule amafolda abiwe, futhi usakaze ideskithophu yakho. Iya ku-Personalize ukuze ushintshe ulimi, itimu, izimo zamakhadi, nemibala. Vula i-FAQ nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma udinga usizo ngokubhangqa, ukudluliswa kwefayela, noma ukulungisa ideskithophu ekude.

Indlela esheshayo yokuxhuma iwukuskena ikhodi ye-QR. 1. Vula iwindi le-RemEx ku-PC yakho 2. Ekhasini layo lasekhaya, chofoza ‘Pair a phone’ 3. Efoni yakho, thepha ‘Add a PC’ esikrinini sokuxhuma, bese ‘Scan QR code’ 4. Skena ikhodi bese uqinisekisa i-PIN yokubhangqa uma ucelwa I-RemEx igcina imininingwane yokuxhumana okuphephile ngokuzenzakalelayo.
I-RemEx ihlulekile ukuqala injini yayo yokuxhuma
Ukufinyelela kunethiwekhi yendawo kunqatshiwe. I-RemEx ayikwazi ukuxhuma ku-PC yakho ngaphandle kwale mvume ku-Android 17+. Sicela uyinikeze kuzilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza.
Ubunikazi bokuphepha bale PC bushintshile. Uma uphinde wafaka i-RemEx ku-PC, susa ukubhangqa bese ubhangqa futhi.
Ayikwazanga ukuqala injini yokuxhuma ye-RemEx. Zama ukuqalisa kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza; uma lokhu kuqhubeka kwenzeka, faka kabusha i-RemEx.
Le PC iphendula ngobunikazi bokuphepha obuhlukile kunalobo obubhangqwe nefoni yakho.
Lokho kulindelekile uma uphinde wafaka i-RemEx noma i-Windows ku-PC, noma ushintshe izinto zayo zekhompyutha.
Uma kungekho kulokho okwenzekile, yima. Kungenzeka kukhona okunye okuphendulayo kuleli kheli futhi okufunda lokho okuthumelayo.
Ukubhangqa kabusha kukwenza ukhohlwe ubunikazi obuthenjwa yifoni yakho bese uqala ukubhangqa futhi. Uzodinga i-PIN eboniswe ku-PC.

Le PC ayiphendulanga, ngakho ubunikazi bayo bamanje abukwazanga ukufundwa. Phinda ubhangqe kuphela uma wazi ukuthi kungani kushintshile.
Le PC iphendula ngobunikazi ifoni yakho esebuvele ibuthemba, ngakho akukho okufanele kulungiswe. Ukuxhumana kwehluleke ngenxa yesinye isizathu.
Ukubhangqa kwehlulekile ngenxa yesizathu esingalindelekile. Zama futhi — uma kuqhubeka kwenzeka, khipha ukubhangqa kwale PC ocingweni lwakho bese ubhangqa kusukela ekuqaleni.
Izimpendulo mayelana nokubhangqa, izimvume, ukudluliswa kwefayela nokusebenza kwedeskithophu ekude.
Engeza izinhlelo ohlwini lwezinhlelo ku-RemEx kukhompyutha yakho, bese uvuselela.

I-PC yakho ayithumelanga uhlu lwayo lwezinhlelo zokusebenza. Hlola ukuthi i-RemEx ivuliwe yini ku-PC, bese uzama futhi.
Izenzo ezivala izinhlelo zikucela ukuba uqinisekise kuqala. Ukuvala nokuvula kabusha kungase kulinde imizuzwana embalwa ngaphambi kokuba kusebenze.
Kuvala izinhlelo zakho ezivuliwe. I-PC ihlala ivuliwe, kodwa i-RemEx ayikwazi ukuyifinyelela uze ungene ngemvume futhi lapho.

Vumela i-PC yehlise ukulungiswa kokusakaza ukuze igcine izinga lozimele. Isithombe singase sime kancane uma sishintsha.

Qiniseka ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-RemEx lusebenza ku-PC yakho nokuthi womabili amadivayisi aku-Wi-Fi efanayo.
Faka uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-RemEx ku-PC ofuna ukuyilawula. Yigcine isebenza ngaphambi kokuthi uxhumeke kusuka kufoni yakho.
Ifoni yakho ne-PC kumele kube kunethiwekhi yendawo efanayo. Idatha yeselula ngeke isebenze.

Iphothali ezenzakalelayo ithi 5005. Uma le divayisi ingakabhangqwa, faka i-PIN enamadijithi angu-6 eboniswe yi-PC ukuze uqedele ukubhangqa okuphephile.
Vula i-Command Prompt bese uthayipha: ipconfig Bheka \"IPv4 Address\" ngaphansi kwe-adaptha yakho ye-Wi-Fi.
Vula itheminali bese uthayipha: ip addr Bheka ikheli le-inet kusixhumi sakho senethiwekhi (isib. wlan0 noma eth0).
I-IP yendawo yekhompyutha yakho — ithole nge-ipconfig (Win) noma ip addr (Linux)
Kudingeka i-Wake-on-LAN — thola ku-Device Manager noma ku-ip link
Ngokuvamile 255.255.255.255 — shintsha kuphela uma i-WOL yehluleka
Kudingeka kuphela ekubhangqeni kokuqala; shiya kungenalutho uma sekubhangqiwe kakade
Le foni izoyikhohlwa le PC, kuyo yonke ikheli ephendula kulo. Uzodinga i-PIN eboniswe ku-PC ukuze ubhangqe futhi.
I-PC iphendulile, kodwa ayisayazi le foni, ngakho ngeke yabelane ngalutho okwamanje. Thepha okuthi Pair, bese uskena ikhodi evela kokuthi ‘Pair a phone’ ku-PC.
Le foni ayibhangqiwe kuleli kheli. Faka i-PIN enamadijithi angu-6 eboniswe ku-PC.

Phequlula okukhishiwe, bika izinkinga, futhi ufake inkanyezi kuphrojekthi uma i-RemEx ikusiza.
Ifoni yakho ne-PC yakho manje kusefolda eyodwa kuzo zombili izinhlelo zokusebenza. Vula amafolda izinga nezinga, futhi isihlahla sikulandela njengoba uphequlula.
Khetha ifayela ukuze ulibone ngokushesha: izithombe ngekhwalithi ephelele ngokusondeza, kanye nombhalo, ikhodi namalogi ngemibala. Vula i-Live ukuze ulandele ilogi njengoba ikhula.

Ukudluliswa manje kuthi Kuqinisekisiwe lapho isigxivizo somunwe saso sihloliwe. Kopisha isigxivizo somunwe sefayela, siqhathanise naleso osinamathiselayo, noma usihlole ngokumelene nekhophi kwenye idivayisi.
Thumela amafayela efoni kufolda ekwi-PC yakho, noma ulondoloze amafayela e-PC kufolda esefonini yakho. Ku-PC ungaphinda uhudule amafayela usuka kudivayisi eyodwa uwayise kwenye.
Engeza amafolda kusuka ocingweni lwakho ukuze uwaphequlule futhi uwabuke ku-RemEx. I-PC yakho ibona elilodwa kuphela uma uvula okuthi Yabelana ne-PC.
Isikrini ngasinye sefayela manje sinenkinobho eyodwa enkulu, kanti ezinye zingaphansi kwezinketho ezengeziwe, futhi ukuthepha ifayela ohlwini manje kuvula ukubuka kuqala kwalo.

Ekhasini lasekhaya le-PC, ikhadi elithi Get the phone app manje selikhombisa ikhodi ye-QR. Khomba ikhamera yefoni yakho kuyo ukuze uvule i-RemEx ku-Google Play.

Udinga uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-RemEx olusebenza kukhompyutha yakho (Windows noma Linux). Iwuhlelo lokusebenza olulodwa kuphela olufaka kukhompyutha. Luqala ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ungena ngemvume futhi lulindele ifoni yakho echwebeni 5005. Konke okudingayo kufakiwe. Sebenzisa isifaki seplathifomu yakho ekhasini lokukhishwa kwe-GitHub, noma khipha ifolda yokukhishwa bese uyisebenzisa.
Ngiwuthola kanjani ikheli le-IP le-PC yami?

Windows: Vulani i-Command Prompt bese uthayipha \'ipconfig\'. Bheka umugqa othi \'IPv4 Address\' ngaphansi kwe-adapter yakho yenethiwekhi esebenzayo (isib. 192.168.1.42). Linux: Vulani i-terminal bese usebenzisa: ip addr noma hostname -I Ungaphinde ubone i-IP ngokuqondile efasiteleni le-RemEx ku-PC yakho.
Ukutholakala okuzenzakalelayo akuyitholi i-PC yami. Yini okufanele ngiyihlole?

1. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-RemEx lusebenza ku-PC yakho: bheka iwindi le-RemEx noma isithonjana sayo sethreyi. 2. Zombili izidivayisi kumele zibe kunethiwekhi efanayo ye-Wi-Fi. 3. I-RemEx idinga imvume yamadivayisi aseduze, futhi ku-Android 17 nangaphezulu idinga nemvume yenethiwekhi yendawo. I-RemEx icela lezi uma uthepha okuthi ‘Thola ngokuzenzakalelayo’. Uma uthe cha, zivule kuzilungiselelo ze-Android → Izinhlelo zokusebenza → RemEx → Izimvume. 4. Amanye ama-router anokuthi ‘AP Isolation’ noma ‘Client Isolation’ avuliwe, okumisa amadivayisi kunethiwekhi ukuthi angabonani. Hlola izilungiselelo ze-router yakho. 5. Amanethiwekhi e-Wi-Fi omsebenzi nawesivakashi avame ukumisa amadivayisi ukuthi angatholani. Zama inethiwekhi yomuntu siqu noma yasekhaya esikhundleni salokho.

I-port ezenzakalelayo ithi 5005. Uma leyo port isivele isetshenziswa, i-RemEx iqala ihlole ukuthi ikhophi endala yayo iyayibamba yini bese iyayithatha; uma lokho kwehluleka, ibuyela ku-port elandelayo yamahhala (5006, 5007 njalo njalo, kuze kufike ku-5009). Ungabona i-port esebenzayo efasiteleni le-RemEx. Uma ushintshe i-port ohlangothini lwe-PC, qiniseka ukuthi ufaka i-port efanayo esikrinini sokuxhuma (Connection screen) kulolu hlelo lokusebenza.

Uma uxhuma ku-PC okokuqala, kufanele ufake i-PIN enamadijithi angu-6 eboniswe ku-PC. Lokhu kudala ukuboshwa okuphephile nokubethelwe phakathi kwamadivayisi. Ngeke udinge ukufaka i-PIN futhi ngaphandle uma usetha kabusha uxhumano noma uphinda ufake uhlelo lokusebenza.

Yebo — ngokuphephile, usebenzisa i-Tailscale (kunconyiwe). I-Tailscale yakha inethiwekhi eyimfihlo, ebethelwe kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni phakathi kwamadivayisi akho (usebenzisa i-WireGuard®), ngakho lolu hlelo lokusebenza lungafinyelela i-PC yakho kusuka noma yikuphi — idatha yeselula, i-Wi-Fi yomsebenzi, indawo yokudlela — ngaphandle kokusetha irutha futhi akukho okudalulwe ku-inthanethi yomphakathi. Bona \'Ngiwusetha kanjani ukufinyelela okukude okuphephile nge-Tailscale?\' ngezansi ukuze uthole imiyalelo yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo. Akunconyiwe: ungavula imbobo kurutha yakho bese uxhuma nge-IP yakho yomphakathi, kodwa lokho kuveza i-PC yakho ku-inthanethi futhi kuyingozi enkulu yezokuphepha. Sebenzisa i-Tailscale (noma enye i-VPN efana ne-WireGuard) esikhundleni salokho.
Isikrini sedeskithophu siyabambeka noma asisebenzi. Ngingenzani?

• Yehlisa isilayidi sekhwalithi (Quality slider) ngaphansi kwezilungiselelo zeDesktop → Stream. • Yehlisa i-Target FPS. Isebenza kusukela ku-120, okuyinombolo ephezulu kunokuba isithembiso: i-PC ithumela ozimele (frames) abambalwa uma inethiwekhi yakho noma i-PC ingakwazi ukuhambisana nayo. Uma isithombe sisaqhaqhazela, i-30–60 FPS yanele ukusetshenziswa kwansuku zonke. • Yehlisa isikali (Scale) ukuze unciphise ukucaca (resolution) okusakazwayo. • I-RemEx izikhethela yona indlela esheshayo yokuthatha isikrini se-PC yakho, ngakho-ke akukho okudinga ukushintshwa lapho. • Qinisekisa ukuthi usebenzisa inethiwekhi ye-Wi-Fi yasendaweni esheshayo (kukhethwa i-5 GHz).

I-Wake-on-LAN ikuvumela ukuthi uvule i-PC yakho ukude ngokuthumela \"isignali yokuvusa\" ngenethiwekhi. Ukuze uyisebenzise: 1. Vula i-WOL kuzilungiselelo ze-BIOS/UEFI ze-PC yakho. 2. Vula i-WOL ezakhiweni ze-adaptha yenethiwekhi yakho (Windows: Umphathi Wedivayisi → I-adaptha Yenethiwekhi → Ukuphathwa Kwamandla). 3. Xhuma kwi-PC yakho kanye ngenkathi ivuliwe. I-RemEx ifunda ikheli layo le-MAC ngaleso sikhathi; udinga kuphela ukulifaka esikrinini sokuxhuma uma i-RemEx ingakwazanga ukulithola kwi-PC. 4. Sebenzisa ikhadi elithi ‘Wake PC’ ku-%1$s noma esikrinini Semiyalo. Ukuvusa i-PC akufani nokubuyisela ukufinyelela kuyo. I-Wake-on-LAN ivula umshini futhi ume esikrinini sokungena ngemvume; i-RemEx iqala kuphela uma othile engena ngemvume kwi-PC uqobo.

Vula ithebhu ethi Okwengeziwe → Izilungiselelo → Yenza kube ngokwakho. Ungashintsha: • Iphalethi yetimu nombala oyisisekelo • I-radius yekhona lekhadi nezimo ezisethiwe • Uhlobo lwefonti nesikali • Ukukhanya kwekhadi • Imodi yetimu emnyama/ekhanyayo/yesistimu • Ulimi lohlelo lokusebenza (oluzimele kulimi lwesistimu yakho)
Yebo! Vula ithebhu ethi Okwengeziwe → Izilungiselelo → Usizo. Lapho uzothola inketho yokuphinda isifundo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
Ngingakwenza kanjani ukufinyelela okukude okuphephile nge-Tailscale?

I-Tailscale ikuvumela ukuthi ufinyelele i-PC yakho kusuka noma yikuphi — ngokuphepha, ngaphandle kokudlulisela imbobo (port-forwarding) futhi akukho okudalulwe ku-inthanethi yomphakathi. Kumahhala ukusetshenziswa komuntu siqu. 1. Ku-PC yakho: • Windows: faka i-Tailscale kusuka ku-tailscale.com/download/windows, bese ungena ngemvume. • Linux: sebenzisa: curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sh sudo tailscale up 2. Kule foni: • Faka i-Tailscale kusuka ku-Google Play Store. • Ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti EFANAYO oyisebenzise ku-PC yakho. • Vula inkinobho ye-VPN ye-Tailscale. 3. Thola i-IP ye-Tailscale ye-PC yakho: • Kuhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Tailscale (noma ikhonsoli yomphathi ku-login.tailscale.com), thola i-PC yakho bese ukopisha i-IP yayo. Iqala ngo-100. — isibonelo 100.101.102.103. 4. Xhuma ku-RemEx: • Vula isikrini Sokuxhuma bese uxhuma mathupha kulelo kheli elingu-100.x.y.z usebenzisa imbobo ye-RemEx (okuzenzakalelayo 5005). • Bhalisa nge-PIN okokuqala, njengasenethiwekhi yakho yasekhaya. Kuphelele lapho — i-RemEx manje isebenza kusuka noma yikuphi, ibethelwe ngokugcwele. Ithiphu: ukutholakala okuzenzakalelayo kusebenza kuphela kunethiwekhi yakho yendawo, ngakho-ke nge-Tailscale xhuma njalo ngokufaka i-IP engu-100.x.y.z mathupha.
Ngiwadlulisa kanjani amafayela phakathi kwefoni yami ne-PC?

Vula ithebhu ethi Okuningi → Amafayela ukuze uphequlule okwasekhaya (Ifoni) nokukude (PC) eceleni, bese usebenzisa Layisha ↑ / Landa ↓ ukuhambisa amafayela phakathi kwawo. Zombili izinhlangothi ziveza kuphela amafolda owabelane ngawo ngokusobala: • Ku-PC: engeza ifolda eyabiwe kusuka ekhasini lamafayela lohlelo lokusebenza lwe-RemEx PC. • Efoni: iya kokuthi Izilungiselelo → Amafayela bese wengeza ifolda — lokhu kuvumela i-PC ukuthi iphequlule kuleyo folda efoni yakho futhi. Ungaphina amafolda njengezinqamuleli, uqambe kabusha noma ususe amafayela, futhi ukhethe izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ukudluliselwa kubonisa inqubekelaphambili ebukhoma kusaziso futhi kuyaqhubeka ngemuva.
I-RemEx ngokuzumayo iyala ukuxhuma / ingicela ukuba ngibhangqe kabusha. Kungani?

Okokuqala uma ubhangqa, ifoni yakho ikhumbula isitifiketi se-PC yakho futhi izothemba leyo PC kuphela. Uma isitifiketi sishintsha — isibonelo ngemva kokufaka kabusha i-RemEx ku-PC, ukubuyisela i-PC kusuka kusipele, noma ukuthuthela kwehadiwe entsha — ifoni yakho yenqaba ukuxhumana ngokufanele esikhundleni sokuthemba umkhohlisi. Lokhu kuwukuziphatha kokuphepha okulindelekile, hhayi iphutha. Ukuze ulungise lokhu, susa (ungabhangqi) i-PC esikrinini sokuxhuma, bese ubhangqa futhi usebenzisa i-PIN entsha enamadijithi angu-6 eboniswe ku-PC.
Ishintsha ulimi lokubonisa lolu hlelo lokusebenza futhi isebenza ngokushesha. Okunye okubhaliwe kungase kuhlale ngesiNgisi kuze kube yilapho izinguqulo seziphelele.
Faka umbala kuhlelo lokusebenza kusuka kusithombe sangemuva sakho. Cisha ukuze usebenzise iphalethi ye-RemEx.

Xhuma ku-PC yakho kuqala ukuze uthole izinzwa.

I-Android ingase ifake i-RemEx ekulaleni ukuze yonge ibhethri, okungase kuphazamise ukuxhumana kwakho ne-PC. Thepha okuthi ‘Vumela i-RemEx isebenze ngemuva’ ngezansi ukuze ukuxhumana kwakho kuhlale kuzinzile.
Xhuma kwi-PC ukuze uphequlule amafayela akude.
Le PC ayikavezi amafolda abelwe okwamanje.
Kuvele kukhona ifayela noma ifolda enaleli gama kufolda oya kuyo.
Kukhona okuhlukile okunaleli gama kufolda okuyiwa kuyo.
Leli gama lide kakhulu kufolda yendawo oya kuyo.
Okunye kuthathe igama elisha ngaphambi kokuthi lokhu kulondolozwe. Ukuzama futhi kuzokhetha igama elihlukile.
